descriptions.mx25oc_nested_vector_fill_insert_8034e63: Inserts n copies of a vector of 12-byte records before a position in a vector of such 16-byte vectors: with enough spare capacity it copy-constructs a saved copy of the value, shifts the tail up (copy-constructing past the end, then assigning backwards through the external inner assignment), assigns the gap from the saved copy and destroys it; otherwise it allocates old size plus the larger of old size and n, copy-constructs the head, the new values and the tail, destroys and frees every old inner vector and the old block, and sets begin, finish and storage end.
